nodes.summary: Let $d$ be a natural number and let $a_0, a_1, a_2, \dots$ be a sequence of points of $\mathbb{R}^d$. The sequence contains a three-term arithmetic progression when there are indices $i$, $j$, $k$ with $a_i \ne a_j$ and $a_i + a_k = 2 a_j$.
nodes.title: Three-term arithmetic progressions in a sequence of points

nodes.summary: Let $d$ be a natural number. A sequence $a_0, a_1, a_2, \dots$ of points of $\mathbb{R}^d$ is a unit-step walk when for every $i$ the step $a_{i+1} - a_i$ is a standard unit vector $e_j$ of $\mathbb{R}^d$ for some $j$.
nodes.title: Unit-step walks

nodes.summary: For every natural number $d$, every sequence $a_0, a_1, a_2, \dots$ of points of $\mathbb{R}^d$ whose steps $a_{i+1} - a_i$ are all standard unit vectors contains a three-term arithmetic progression (indices $i$, $j$, $k$ with $a_i \ne a_j$ and $a_i + a_k = 2 a_j$) if and only if $d \le 3$.
nodes.title: Solution of Erdős Problem 192 on three-term progressions in unit-step walks

nodes.summary: The statement that for every natural number $d$, every sequence $a_0, a_1, a_2, \dots$ of points of $\mathbb{R}^d$ whose steps $a_{i+1} - a_i$ are all standard unit vectors contains a three-term arithmetic progression (indices $i$, $j$, $k$ with $a_i \ne a_j$ and $a_i + a_k = 2 a_j$) if and only if $d \le 3$.
nodes.title: Erdős Problem 192 on three-term progressions in unit-step walks

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
